blocks.text: COTABATO CITY – The Ministry of Basic, Higher and Technical Education (MBHTE) in the Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao (BARMM) is spearheading the creation of a multi-sectoral School Safety Task Force (SSTF) to protect learners, educators, and the general public against school violence across the region. Lawyer Abubakar Katambak, MBHTE deputy minister, said Wednesday the move is to ensure the safety and security of schools, teachers and learners across the Bangsamoro region, following the fatal campus shooting in Banga, South Cotabato over the weekend.
